title: Scattering theory for bulk and surface waves in an impedance half-space, I: radiation conditions and a Rellich-type theorem
summary: We study the negative Laplacian on the half-space $\mathbb{R}^n_+$, $n \ge 3$, subject to a constant impedance (Robin) boundary condition with $α> 0$. The boundary then carries a bound transverse mode, and at each energy $E > 0$ the system propagates two channels with the distinct wavenumbers $\sqrt{E}$ and $\sqrt{E+α^2}$: bulk waves decaying like $|x|^{-(n-1)/2}$ and surface waves decaying like $|x'|^{-(n-2)/2}$.
